column1: # Memory purge & UMA pressure guard decision vectors, shared by Rust tests and C++ unit tests.
# 5: gpu_shared_usage_mb (global PDH "GPU Adapter Memory" Shared Usage; dedicated usage is 0 in every row)
#     PURGE_LOW = level 1 (low-priority standby + trim), PURGE_FULL = level 2 (whole standby list + trim)
# 16: last_purge_level (0|1|2): level applied earlier in this same pressure episode
# Rows that were PURGE_AND_TRIM before E2.3 are PURGE_LOW: with last_purge_level 0 it is the first attempt of the episode.
# E2.3 plan table #1: UMA, free 1000 MB, standby 4 GB, first attempt -> level 1
# #2: after the pause the pressure is still there and level 1 was the last purge -> level 2
# level 2 does not climb further: it stays at 2 while the pressure lasts
# #3: the pressure went away in one tick (C++ resets last_purge_level to 0) and came back -> level 1 again
# #3b: global shared usage above the budget (6000 > 4096) is clamped to 1.0 (checked in Rust), level follows the rule
# #4: standby below the minimum on a discrete GPU -> no purge
# #5: inside the pause -> no purge and COOLDOWN, even with last_purge_level 1
# #6: game reads the disk above the cap -> no purge and DISK_IO
# #7: PDH failed (vram_valid 0): the GPU signal is ignored, RAM alone decides (plenty of RAM -> none, low RAM -> level 1)
# #8: budget 0: no division, the GPU signal is ignored, RAM decides
# #10: discrete GPU at 98% of its budget does not count as a GPU signal
# E2.3: critical free RAM (1200 <= free < 1536) now also counts as pressure when there is enough standby
